gap: No result ChatGPT got states named colour-shift measurements for ND filters. Examples: The Slanted Lens measured the PolarPro (Peter McKinnon) variable ND at -300 K and +9 magenta at 5 stops, and its '9' mark gave only 7.3 stops. Ewen Bell measured a K&F ND64 at 0 to +3% correction per colour channel, against up to +5% blue for a Moment 2-5 stop VND at its lightest setting.
standout_why: ChatGPT ran no search and got no results. It showed no product cards and cited no pages, so there was no rival page to compare against. Its answer only described fixed and variable ND types and asked a follow-up question. It gave no measured colour cast, no real stop counts and no named tester. Any named measurement is new. It does not reach 3 because no lab I could open measured the exact K&F ND2-32 True Color 67/77 mm VND that Dealectric lists. The closest tests are a K&F Variable NDX 2-32 (Photography News) and K&F fixed or unspecified ND8/ND64 filters (Ewen Bell). Most of these tests are also from 2016-2023.
decides: The measurements back a 1-5 stop variable ND like the K&F ND2-32 for video. Photography News found the scale on the K&F 2-32 'spot on' and saw only a minor warm shift at the strongest settings. Ewen Bell measured K&F at 0 to +3% correction per channel and called it 'very good given their price point'. Wider-range VNDs fall short of their markings and shift colour more: the PolarPro '9' mark measured 7.3 stops with -400 K and +6 magenta at the '6' mark. For long exposures beyond 5 stops, the data points to a fixed ND instead. Fstoppers found the Breakthrough X3 and Hoya fixed 6-stop filters the most neutral, while the Tiffen ran about 3/4 stop darker than its rating.
candidates: K&F Concept ND2-32 True Color Variable ND (Nano-Xcel)

The page doesn't say which K&F model was tested; these are probably fixed NDs, not the True Color VND.

findings.label: Exposure accuracy (Fstoppers, Patrick Hall)
findings.value: About 3/4 stop more than its 6-stop rating; the Breakthrough X3 ND6 and Formatt Hitech ND1.8 were nearly exactly 6 stops
findings.source_title: Neutral density filters aren't so neutral after all: Fstoppers reviews five popular ND filters (Imaging Resource)
findings.note: Imaging Resource summary dated 2016-02-10 of fstoppers.com/bestfiltertest. 82mm filters on a Nikon D750 with a Tamron 24-70. On colour cast, Breakthrough and Hoya XPD did best and Tiffen and Formatt Hitech worst, but the article gives no numbers. B+W and Formatt Hitech vignetted the most.

findings.label: Spectral transmission ratio (Camera Butter, a filter seller)
findings.value: About 3x more transmission at the red end than the violet end
findings.source_title: ND Filter Quality: What Actually Matters and How We Test It - Camera Butter
findings.note: Dated 2026-08-30. Measured with a scanning spectrophotometer of unnamed make. Camera Butter sells competing filters, so this is a rival's measurement. It measured its own ND8/16/32/64 at 550.5 nm within +0.12/-0.06/+0.08/-0.04 stops of their ratings.
